integrity: The all-base theorem is proved by exact recurrence identities, inequalities and a complete case split. The finite verifier is auxiliary and reproducible; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only exactly one right-appended digit per transition in a fixed integer base, and classical second-kind Lucas numbers. Does not address block appending, other companion parameter choices, or independent priority. Finite checks are not the infinite proof.
title: A sharp three-term bound for Lucas digit-appending walks in every base
